title: Introduction to Programming
description: Covers basic Python programming including variables, loops, conditionals, functions, and simple data structures.

title: Data Structures
description: Explores core data structures such as arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, trees, and graphs. Focuses on implementation and complexity analysis.

title: Discrete Mathematics
description: Introduces logic, proofs, combinatorics, sets, relations, functions, induction, recurrence relations, and basic graph theory.

title: Algorithms
description: Covers algorithmic paradigms including divide and conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and graph algorithms such as BFS, DFS, and shortest path.

title: Operating Systems
description: Discusses threads, processes, CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O systems, synchronization, deadlocks, and file systems.

title: Database Systems
description: Introduces relational databases, SQL, indexing, query optimization, transactions, normalization, and NoSQL models.

title: Computer Networks
description: Covers networking basics: TCP/IP, routing, congestion control, DNS, HTTP, sockets, and network security fundamentals.

title: Machine Learning
description: Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, including regression, classification, decision trees, SVMs, clustering, and feature engineering.

title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Introduces search algorithms, knowledge representation, probabilistic reasoning, reinforcement learning fundamentals, and planning.

title: Deep Learning
description: Explores neural networks, backpropagation, convolutional networks, recurrent networks, transformers, and training optimizations.

title: Data Mining
description: Focuses on clustering, association rule mining, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection, and large-scale pattern discovery.

title: Linear Algebra
description: Covers vector spaces, matrices, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, orthogonality, projections, and applications in machine learning.
